sonnet.problem: The line 'not the Barzillai of Gilead' states a fact from outside the passage without its reference in brackets. It also adds a contrast the passage doesn't make.
sonnet.rule: A fact from outside it gives its reference in brackets in the card's text, like "Jeremiah, a prophet (Jeremiah 1:5)."

sonnet.problem: This choice card asks what the Gibeonites request (verse 6) before any story card has told verses 5-6. The only context is the question itself, so the baker can't reason out 'seven' and can only guess. The story card that sets up the request (card 10) comes after the question is answered.
sonnet.rule: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer. ... If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

sonnet.problem: This story card repeats 'Whatever you ask…', which was the answer to card 8, and 'the seven', which was the answer to card 9. It spends a card on facts already shown instead of moving the passage forward.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
